title: Signed Fourier atom
statement: For a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, a subset $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and an input $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, define the signed Fourier atom as the sign of $\widehat f(S)$ multiplied by the monomial $\prod_{i\in S}x_i$.
